context: UserList renders a list of users with a remove button. Users can be removed and reordered via drag-and-drop.
explanation: Using array index as the key on a reorderable, removable list causes React to reuse DOM nodes incorrectly after mutations — removed items show stale content and drag-and-drop visually corrupts the list. Fix: keep key={user.id} so each item tracks its identity across reorders.
